Roth }} '''Herald of Agony''' is a [[herald]] [[skill gem]]. When activated it [[mana reservation|reserves mana]] and grants a [[buff]] that gives a chance to inflict [[poison]] on enemies. Whenever the user poisons an enemy, it grants Virulence and summons an Agony Crawler [[minion]], which becomes stronger with more stacks of Virulence. ==Skill functions and interactions== ===Virulence=== Virulence is gained by poisoning enemies, 1 for each poison. Poisoning while at 0 Virulence grants 2 Virulence instead. Reflecting poison to yourself with {{il|The Golden Rule}} grants 1 additional Virulence per poison. The regular maximum is 40 stacks, which can be raised with the [[Cluster Jewel]] notable passive [[Pure Agony]], additional quality on the gem gained via methods such as {{il|Enhance}} or {{il|Ashes of the Stars}}, and from the [[Herald (ascendancy class)|Herald's]] [[Scourge (ascendancy passive skill)|Scourge]] node. Virulence decays at an accelerating rate based on the number of stacks you have. Stacks have a base duration rate of 533ms, minus 12.5ms per stack of Virulence capping out at a minimum duration of 33ms (1 server tick) at 40+ stacks. In other words, poison must be inflicted at a rate of 30 stacks per second to sustain maximum Virulence higher than 40.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/1ad7lo5/herald_of_agony_virulence_decay_rate/ Virulence's physical damage bonuses are not limited to attacks, and will also apply to the minion's [[secondary damage]] such as {{psl|Profane Bloom}} or {{il|Annihilation Support}}. ===Minion=== Agony Crawler Minion has an implicit 40% [[Physical damage|Physical]] to [[Chaos damage]] [[Damage conversion|conversion]]. Minion damage can be increased through many methods, such as: * Gem level boosts, such as {{il|The Coming Calamity}}, {{il|Cold Iron Point}}, and {{il|Empower Support}}. * The Ring {{il|Circle Of Nostalgia}} has modifiers that directly buff the skill * Auras like {{il|Hatred}} supported by {{il|Generosity Support|Generosity}}. * The [[Lone Messenger]] keystone, at the expense of not being able to use any auras. * [[Frenzy Charge#Effects on monsters and minions|Frenzy charges]] can be granted to minions through the {{il|Victario's Charity}} shield, or {{il|Poacher's Mark}} curse. * Support gems such as: {{il|Minion Damage Support|Minion Damage}}, {{il|Point Blank Support|Point Blank}}, and {{il|Vile Toxins Support|Vile Toxins}} also offer a considerable boost to minion damage. The Crawler is also [[Immunity|immune]] to any form of damage and cannot die, making {{il|Damage on Full Life Support|Damage on Full Life}} a great option. * Temporary effects such as {{il|Flesh Offering}}, {{il|Spirit Offering}}, {{il|Vaal Haste}}, and {{il|Vaal Lightning Trap}} can also be taken advantage of. * [[Debuff]]s such as [[Intimidate]] from {{il|Belt of the Deceiver}} also increase minion damage. * [[Curse]]s like {{il|Sniper's Mark}} also work.{{confirm|3.12 change}} For faster clear speed consider supports such as {{il|Pierce Support|Pierce}}, {{il|Greater Multiple Projectiles Support|Greater Multiple Projectiles}}, {{il|Faster Attacks Support|Faster Attacks}}, and {{il|Minion Speed Support|Minion Speed}}. Consider using {{il|Convocation}} to quickly teleport the Crawler to your location. Ie, T6 is the highest tier): {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Herald%of%Agony%" AND mods.generation_type = 28 |stat_text=1 |level=1 |spawn_weights=1 |q_orderBy=mods.id ASC }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Herald of Agony%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Herald of Agony%" OR items.description LIKE "%your herald becomes%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Gallery== File: CelestialHeraldofAgonyScorpion.png|thumb|Scorpion with Celestial Herald Effect ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Alternate quality gems, labyrinth helmet enchantments and unique threshold jewels are all systems that were trying to subtly modify the behaviour of skills. With this expansion these have been combined into a new system called Transfigured Gems that allows us to fully achieve the goal of these three systems, and then some. * Herald of Agony's quality now provides +0-5 to Maximum Virulence, instead of 0-20% increased Minion Movement Speed. * Anomalous, Divergent and Phantasmal Quality Gems have been removed from the game. Existing alternate Quality Gems now have the base Quality effect found on the respective Gem. * The Divine Font at the end of the Labyrinth is now a gem crafting device that can modify your skill and support gems. (Previously enchant helmet, gloves or boots) Existing items with Labyrinth enchantments are not affected. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * The damage and life scaling values for minions have been adjusted. Generally speaking, minion life and damage is unchanged in the very early game, roughly 30% lower in mid acts, roughly 20% lower at level 20 of the minion skill, and roughly 10% lower at level 30 of the minion skill. * Agony Crawler now gains 2% increased Attack Speed per Virulence you have at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 4% at gem level 20 (previously 3%). }} {{Version history table row|3.10.0| * Agony Crawler now deals 5% increased physical damage per Virulence you have at gem level 1 (from 6%), up to 9% at gem level 20 (from 12%). }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Now causes Agony Crawler to deal 6% increased physical damage per virulence you have at gem level 1 (from 10%), up to 12% at gem level 20 (from 19%). }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * The Agony Crawler summoned by this skill now deals increased Physical Damage per Virulence you have, rather than increased Damage. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.2| * The Herald of Agony skill gem now has a Chaos tag. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.1| * Fixed a bug where Blood Guard Herald and Faith Guard Herald effects were reversed when applied to Herald of Agony. }} {{Version history table row|3.4.0| * Herald of Agony has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
